st_2p3.text: The closed circles in Fig. 4 are the measured static structure factor S(k), by (6). The values shown have been increased by a factor of 2.3, giving rough agreement with S(k) from Bogoliubov theory in the LDA (4). ... The open circles are computed from (2), using the measured values of omega(k) shown in Fig. 3a. ... FIG. 4. The filled circles are the measured static structure factor, multiplied by an overall constant of 2.3.

st_feynman.source: J. Steinhauer, R. Ozeri, N. Katz, N. Davidson, The Excitation Spectrum of a Bose-Einstein Condensate, PRL 88, 120407 (2002)
st_feynman.text: In general, the f-sum rule [1] yields Feynman's relation [11] S(k) = (hbar k^2 / 2m) / omega(k) (2). Eq. 2 relates the strength of the resonance to its frequency. ... [11] This relation is derived by other means in R. P. Feynman, Phys. Rev. 94, 262 (1954).
